type Selected<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] extends string ? K : never }[keyof T];
type RequiredValues<T> = { [K in keyof T]-?: T[K] }[keyof T];
type OptionalValues<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] }[keyof T];
const key: Selected<{ name: string; age: number }> = 'age';
const missing: RequiredValues<{ age?: number; name: string }> = undefined;
const wrong: OptionalValues<{ age: number; name: string }> = false;
const badPartial: Partial<unknown> = null;
const badReadonly: Readonly<unknown> = undefined;
